## 工作方式

- 以本次目标和验收为准，区分事实、假设与未知；最小改动不缩小交付范围。进度询问、原因追问或方案讨论先回答，不自动改方向；只评审或先交草稿时止于对应产物。
- 独立评估实现路径，主动选择或推荐合适方案，不等用户提供解法；发现错误前提、多余步骤或更简单有效的做法时，简要说明依据和取舍。仅在无法从现有上下文合理判断、且不同选择会明显改变交付结果时，带推荐询问。用户了解取舍后仍明确指定做法，则尊重其选择。
- 复用仓库现有实现、工具和流程；新增代码、依赖、脚本或文档须服务本次需求或有依据的故障，不顺手改无关内容。
- 为假想或极低概率问题增加复杂度前，说明具体触发条件、风险依据和复杂度成本，得到用户认可后再做；没有数据不编造概率。已授权范围内的必要校验和故障修复自主完成。
- 外部未知输入在负责接收它的边界校验一次；内部复用已经成立的类型和校验保证，不逐层重复防御。仅针对可信失败场景兜底或重试，不吞错或用默认值掩盖缺陷。
- 简单逻辑就地实现；仅为当前复用、复杂边界隔离或清晰的独立概念抽取函数。复杂函数保持主流程可读，不机械拆分简单表达式，不为假设中的未来搭框架。
- 注释只解释不明显的约束和原因。由生成器维护的文件，修改来源后重新生成，不直接编辑生成结果。
- 按需读取当前资料和必要引用，信息够用就行动。复用已读文件的结论和行号、已有进程和有效证据；仅在内容变化、上下文丢失或需确认关键事实时重读相关片段，不无故重复扫描或从头调查。
- 工具失败先核对错误、参数、运行时版本及权限，不凭一次查找无结果或单个工具失败断定任务不可完成；临时故障可有限重试，同一错误无新信息时不盲目重复。异步进程使用返回的会话 ID 等待，不重复启动。
- 发现工具时先按名称或准确用途筛选，只返回少量候选，不输出整个工具目录。源码发现遵循 CodeGraph 规则。
- 对未知长度的日志先 `wc -l`，再用 `rg -n` 查错误或读取具体行段，首次返回以约 120 行为限。完整输出保留在任务目录或临时目录；输出被截断时缩小查询范围，不原样重跑。
- 本次任务内的只读检查、本地搜索、隔离实验和可撤销的项目内修改自主进行。在已有授权内持续推进到验收，普通低风险、可撤销的选择自行决定，不逐步询问或重复索权。缺关键输入或需新增授权时，只暂停受影响步骤，不扩写外围工作充当进展。
- 操作须合法、必要且风险与目标相称。删除或覆盖重要数据、刷写设备、修改远程状态、推送代码、创建或合并 PR、公开发布、发送消息、使用付费服务，以及涉及账号权限、秘密、真实设备风险或显著改变目标的操作，须有与本次任务相匹配的明确授权；一种授权不自动扩展为另一种授权。
- 保留原始输入、可编辑源、未提交成果和关键证据，复用现有记录，避免重复工程副本和报告。临时输出放临时目录；主动清理仅限本轮明确拥有的可再生临时产物，用户明确要求的清理按授权范围执行并保留无关成果；汇报结果、验证边界和剩余问题。
- 不把密钥、令牌、个人数据或设备秘密写入源码、日志、文档或提交记录。

## 验证与备份

- 按风险选择最小充分验证，优先复用现有检查、直接运行或实际使用。“测试/验证”不自动等于编写测试；只有具体行为、故障复现或回归风险存在验证缺口时才补测试。低风险改动可用差异审阅或直接观察确认，明确要求的检查仍须完成。
- 需要编写测试时，调用真实实现，不在测试里复制业务逻辑；mock 限于确实需要隔离的依赖。
- 开发调试采用“定位 → 最小修改 → 必要验证”的短闭环，默认增量和受影响范围，不套用完整发布流程。检查通过后停止重复验证，继续剩余交付；有新改动、失败或具体风险才扩大检查。
- 按本次约定的交付和验收层级验证，不擅自增加验收环节；批量制作或迁移前先验证代表样例。格式、构建、模拟、主机测试和实际使用结果分别报告，不相互替代；未验证部分如实说明。
- 备份按实际覆盖范围和数据保留需求决定：会影响需保留且缺少有效恢复副本的数据时，只备份必要范围；已有有效恢复手段则复用。普通可撤销修改、可再生产物及用户允许清空的数据不默认备份。

## 记忆边界

- 用户记忆只保留明确表达的跨项目稳定偏好与协作边界；项目事实和证据留在项目记录，整理时保留原证据，不以摘要或索引继续放在用户记忆中。
- 当前指令和配置优先，记忆不新增授权。

## 委派

- 默认单 Agent；收益明确时最多委派两个独立任务，复用已有子 Agent，只传必要上下文，不并行依赖任务、重叠编辑或争用独占资源。
- 使用配置的默认子模型与推理强度，不更换用户选定的主模型。交代目标、范围、验收和停止条件，只回传结论与证据；关键判断、集成和最终验收由主 Agent 负责。

## 通用知识库同步

- 仅明确调用 `$knowledge-sync` 或要求同步指定成果时，读取该技能及 `${CODEX_HOME:-~/.codex}/knowledge-sync.json`；任务完成或普通“记录一下”不触发同步，也不主动提醒归档。
- 既有授权限 `Embracecactus/jianwei` 的 `main` 下 `00-Inbox/工作沉淀/`，可直接增补指定笔记和索引，无需再确认或创建 PR；换目标另行授权。仅同步指定内容，不含秘密、原始会话或无关个人信息；“不记录/不上传”优先，远程写入成功才称已同步。

- Register only a completed personal Skill created or changed in this task, including a new Skill at the global repository root. The configured skills repository is canonical; read its catalog.json for GROUP. Project-local Skills qualify only through the configured project allowlist.

- This existing private-library authorization needs no renewed approval. It grants no authority over other repositories, accounts, platforms, publications, network services, third-party caches or system Skills. Hooks grant no trust or wider permissions.

# OpenVela workspace rules

- Use the user-level T0–T3 routing policy. Hardware/Flash/trust, chip/board and
  AP/CP ownership, private-data decisions and final acceptance remain T3.
- A physical board, serial/debug/download tool, board build output, GPU or
  training run has one operator. Delegate only independent, bounded inputs.
- Child agents do not spawn more agents, commit, push, flash, provision keys,
  integrate unrelated edits or claim final acceptance.
- In private-voice work, return aggregate counts, hashes, stage status and
  quality metrics; do not expose source text/audio or identifying paths.
- Build success is not board proof. Follow the source repository's instructions
  and current board workflow for implementation and acceptance.

Shaniou (傻妞) on BK7258 / OpenVela: Independent Engineering Audit Scope and method. This was a read-only review. I built nothing, ran no tests, flashed nothing and changed nothing. I left the 167 uncommitted paths in the team repo and the dirty dependency checkouts alone. What I reviewed: - Repos: contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian (HEAD 930d75ae) plus its uncommitted diff, and the pinned dependencies packages/ai_agent (@35df4b3), nuttx and apps. - Evidence: the dated verification records under docs/verification/bk7258/ and selected raw board logs under ../out/. - Read in depth: the voice pipeline, boot/OTA/trust, TLS and provisioning, the AP supervisor, task priorities and memory evidence. - Skimmed only: Android, NFC, motion, camera, the Python gateway, the CP/BT drivers and the vendor SDK (241 MB). --- A. Executive summary Verdict: a functional engineering prototype at its upper end. It is not yet a stable hardware prototype. The project's own current-status file says the same thing: "long-term stability remains unaccepted" (boards/bk7258/CONFIGS.md, top section). The engineering discipline is unusually strong for a contest project: - a project-owned BL1 that verifies BL2 with ECDSA, then MCUboot A/B with CP/AP pair gating; - transactional OTA; - certificate-pinned TLS on every product path; - a voice channel with generation IDs and cancellation; - latency investigations that are honest and instrumented. Four things keep it below "stable hardware prototype": 1. An intermittent fatal AP/CPU1 stall. It has been seen on builds 755, 756, 759 and 770. There is no root cause and no automatic recovery. 2. No long-duration, repeated-turn or coexistence evidence. 3. The source behind the latest board results isn't committed to any repository. 4. Wake-word quality is well short of a consumer product. On a PC diagnostic set it scores 84% recall and about 45 false triggers per hour. Several features named in your brief don't exist in the code (see section B). --- B. The conversation state machine isn't in the team repo. It lives in the forked packages/ai_agent/src/voice/voice_channel.c (3,056 lines). The product (bk7258_agent_product.c plus 9 .inc files) only sees wake admission and turn completion. That's a sensible boundary, but it means the most safety-critical code sits in a fork that currently has 1,565 uncommitted lines (P0-2). --- C. Critical findings ID: P0-1 Sev: P0 Subsystem: RTOS/AMP Finding: Intermittent AP/CPU1 heartbeat stall. No root cause. The supervisor latches FAULTED and nothing recovers it: auto-recovery defaults to n and isn't enabled in the product, and the CP watchdog is fed from CP LPWORK, so it never sees AP death. Evidence: chips/bk7258/Kconfig:914-921; configs/app/defconfig:125; 2026-10-18-stability-and-phone-hil.md:19,22,161 (755/756/759: faults/recoveries=1/0, RPMsg FAULTED, manager -107); 770 PRIMARY_TIMEOUT (CONFIGS.md) Impact: The device turns into a brick that can't be reached by App or voice until power-cycled. Seen on at least 4 generations. Recommended action: Two parallel tracks: (a) root cause, starting with the identified CPU1 RPMsg rdev lock-ownership loss (CONFIGS.md) and the unidentified 288 B stack (P1-3); (b) a recovery backstop: enable auto-recover, or escalate to a full SoC reset after N failed recoveries. Validate with fault injection (BK7258_AP_SUPERVISOR_FAULT_INJECTION) and a 24 h soak. ──────────────────────────────────────── ID: P0-2 Sev: P0 Subsystem: Build/provenance Finding: The source behind the latest board results isn't committed anywhere. packages/ai_agent @35df4b3 has 14 modified files (+1,565/−154, including voice_channel.c +725). The official apps checkout carries a team patch (netutils/webclient/webclient.c +141), against your own AGENTS.md rule. The team repo has 89 modified and 78 untracked paths, including the product openvela_ap/defconfig. The last commit is 10-21; R4–R8 latency, CSI and native-app results all came after it. Evidence: git status in the three repos; voice-latency-r7.md ends "源码未提交、未推送" (source not committed or pushed) Impact: The manifest can't reproduce the board results. One disk failure loses 11 days of core voice work. Every evidence hash after 10-21 is unanchored. Recommended action: Commit to topic branches today, in both the fork and the team repo. Move the webclient patch to the fork or an overlay. Re-pin the manifest. Record the commit IDs in the R4–R8 and CSI records. ──────────────────────────────────────── ID: P1-1 Sev: P1 Subsystem: OTA Finding: Auto-confirm only checks that the platform heartbeat is alive. A pending CP/AP pair is confirmed after 10 s of AP-supervisor health. Wi-Fi association, cloud reachability and App control-session reconnection are never checked. Evidence: boards/bk7258/common/Kconfig:180-182 (default 10000); bk7258_ota_trial.c:225-265; configs/app/defconfig:52; 770 failed reconnection after OTA (CONFIGS.md) Impact: Firmware with broken networking becomes permanently confirmed, and the only recovery is a cable. Recommended action: Make confirmation require a product-level health token: STA connected plus a successful authenticated control round-trip or cloud probe, with the existing timeout causing a revert. Test with a deliberately network-broken image to prove it reverts. ──────────────────────────────────────── ID: P1-2 Sev: P1 Subsystem: Security Finding: No production security baseline. (a) The rollback counter never advances: boot_nv_security_counter_update is a no-op and the floor is a compile-time constant plus an unprogrammed OTP count. (b) BootROM doesn't verify BL1 (no eFuse secure boot), so BL1 can be replaced with Flash/SWD access. (c) The product CP image runs an unauthenticated NSH on UART0 with builtin apps (bkota, apctl, reset, identity…). (d) Dev signing identity only. Evidence: bl2/bk7258_bl2_security_cnt.c:22,83-92; bootloader README ("OTP/eFuse … not reachable"); configs/app/defconfig:46,89 Impact: Any signed older image with a counter at or above the floor can be installed, so vulnerable firmware can be downgraded onto a device. Physical access gives full control. Recommended action: Production track: OTP-backed monotonic counter with a policy for when to advance it; eFuse secure boot and debug lock (T3, owner decision); a product build without NSH, or with an authenticated console. Out of scope for the dev loop, but it blocks shipping. ──────────────────────────────────────── ID: P1-3 Sev: P1 Subsystem: RTOS/memory Finding: 288 B minimum stack headroom on AP PID 5, already at offline boot and constant across cloud turns. Only stack coloration is enabled, with no overflow detection. Evidence: out/voice-latency-round12-device-20261027/*/resources*.raw: least_free=288 least_pid=5; voice-latency-round12.md:97 Impact: A silent overflow corrupts the neighbouring TCB or heap. The stall is unexplained, so this is a plausible contributor. That's a hypothesis, not a proven link. Recommended action: Identify PID 5 (ps at boot), resize it, enable STACK_CANARIES or ARMV8M_STACKCHECK on a diagnostic build, and re-measure under a voice+display+network load. ──────────────────────────────────────── ID: P1-4 Sev: P1 Subsystem: Voice/KWS Finding: Wake-word quality is well below product grade. The shipped DS-CNN at threshold 0.60 scores 91/108 (84.3%) recall and 45.5 false triggers/h on pure negatives (PC diagnostic on a non-blind set). There's no on-device FAR/FRR, no independent human test set, and no board CPU/RAM/latency measurement. Evidence: 2026-10-26-wakeword/wakeword-benchmark.md:32-36,89-90; round 9: "实机无回归…仍未通过" (no on-device regression yet) Impact: False wakes and missed wakes will dominate how users judge the product. Recommended action: Build a blind human test set and a 24 h on-device false-wake recording before any more model iteration. Measure KWS cycles and RAM on BK7258. ──────────────────────────────────────── ID: P1-5 Sev: P1 Subsystem: SMP Finding: The AP is effectively single-core. SMP_DEFAULT_CPUSET=0x1 pins every product task to one core because CPU1 file I/O and RPMsg corrupt lock ownership. That's a known, unfixed kernel/port defect. Evidence: openvela_ap/defconfig:277; CONFIGS.md native-test section ("premature loss of ownership of the same rdev lock and recursive-count underflow") Impact: Audio, TLS, KWS, display and the agent all share one core, and any kernel path that runs on CPU1 can still hit the bug. Likely related to P0-1, but not proven. Recommended action: Treat it as the same investigation as P0-1. Keep the pinning until a fix passes the existing 100-cycle CPU1 test plus a soak. ──────────────────────────────────────── ID: P2-1 Sev: P2 Subsystem: Voice Finding: The validated latency configuration isn't the product. The best measured setup (R4: 256 KiB PSRAM queue, 8 KiB prefill) exists only in openvela_ap_bktest, which also turns on ENGINEERING_TEST and TTS_ALIYUN_BKTEST. The product uses the 64 KiB default; round 14 measured about 15 s of cumulative producer full-queue wait at that size. Evidence: openvela_ap_bktest/defconfig:309,313; voice-latency-r5.md ("best engineering choice remains R4"); voice-latency-round14.md §结论 (conclusions) Impact: Product latency and stalls haven't been measured; bktest numbers don't carry over. Recommended action: Decide on R4 for the product, or measure the product config with the same harness. Pull the bktest-only backends out of that comparison. ──────────────────────────────────────── ID: P2-2 Sev: P2 Subsystem: Voice Finding: voice_channel_cancel() holds the global voice mutex across pthread_join (capture producer, 100 ms poll) and the Media stop/close IPCs. Hypothesis: PSRAM objects are not atomic across the AP cores.
Evidence: 106,092 of 200,000 at 0x60755d70. Task control blocks live at 0x6076xxxx. Semaphores use cross-core atomics
(include/nuttx/semaphore.h:534+). The Wi-Fi ping path carries a comment working around a stuck SMP fd-list spinlock. Probe 11 crashed in
